R1C1.quote: There's more data than there are searches.

R1C2.quote: We are slaves to the Latin American system.

R1C3.quote: The work is enslaving and poorly-paid.

R1C4.quote: I have trouble sleeping… I live with the computer on 24 hours a day.

R1C5.quote: In Venezuela, you don't live, you survive.

R1C6.quote: I don't like the uncertainty of not knowing when an assignment will come out.

R1C7.quote: I was terrified they would close my account and I'd lose everything.

R1C8.quote: There could come a time when there are simply no more tasks.

R1C9.quote: Annotation work was attractive because it had so few access barriers.

R1C10.quote: The salary doesn't cover half a dozen eggs… not enough to buy bread.

R1C11.quote: It's creepy the things we do for pennies.

R2C1.quote: We all cooperate; we are a team.

R2C2.quote: I used to be an engineer. Now I spend my days clicking.

R2C3.quote: I am treated like a robot; they would prefer I were a robot.

R2C4.quote: They treat us like we're not human.

R2C5.quote: It has been difficult to earn the minimum, which is ten dollars a week.

R2C6.quote: I leave my computer and phone charging all night hoping a task shows up.

R2C7.quote: If the electricity goes out, I lose the task and get penalized.

R2C8.quote: I failed a task because my internet dropped for seconds.

R2C9.quote: I cried when they suspended my account. It meant no food that week.

R2C10.quote: It feels like gambling. Maybe today there is work, maybe not.

R2C11.quote: If a task doesn't come up, I'm just waiting… days, weeks, even months can go by without anything coming up at all.

R2C12.quote: My son helps me with the English words when the tasks are too hard.

R3C1.quote: I worked eight hours and earned less than two dollars.

R3C2.quote: They said I did 'poor quality work' but gave no explanation.

R3C3.quote: I don't understand why the system rejected me. They never tell you.

R3C4.quote: The instructions contradict each other. You end up guessing.

R3C5.quote: If you ask for help, they tell you to read the instructions again.

R3C6.quote: I fail tasks I haven't even started yet.

R3C7.quote: I have a degree, but this is the only job that pays in dollars.

R3C8.quote: I never know how much I will earn this week.

R3C9.quote: When the electricity cuts, everything collapses.

R3C10.quote: The platform banned my husband for no reason. We depended on that money.

R3C11.quote: Sometimes the tasks are disturbing; we have to see violent things.

R3C12.quote: I don't want my kids to see what I have to label.

R4C1.quote: I get migraines from staring at the screen for so long.

R4C2.quote: I wake up at 3 AM to catch the good tasks.

R4C3.quote: Sometimes I fall asleep at the keyboard.

R4C4.quote: I prayed they wouldn't close my account. It was all I had.

R4C5.quote: I used to teach. Now I just click.

R4C6.quote: We do the hard work; the AI gets the credit.

R4C7.quote: I only eat once a day when the tasks are slow.

R4C8.quote: My family depends on every cent I make here.

R4C9.quote: It's humiliating. They score everything we do.

R4C10.quote: My account was closed for 'fraud' even though I did nothing wrong.

R4C11.quote: The platform feels like a lottery. Some days you win, most days you lose.

R4C12.quote: I work 12 hours but only get paid for tasks they accept.
